109: One who calls another a slave - a Canaanite slave.
Shall be ostracized - they would ostracize him, since he has disparaged a Jew to such an extent -- they will also disparage him.
Incurs the forty - they would penalize him with lashes for rebelliousness; this is easier on him than being ostracized.

[If one calls another] a wicked person then he may harass him [in all aspects of] his life - that is to say, the court is not obliged to engage in this case, but [the insulted person] is permitted to hate him, and even to reduce his livelihood and harass him in his business.
